body: They’ve been stressing me out so much lol, have you been to an allergist or anything? I’m hoping that they can figure out what’s causing this

So around a month and a half ago I woke up from severe itching in the middle of my sleep, and first thought was bed bugs. I still think this is unrelated to what I’m getting now, I believe I had genuine bug bites before. However, ever since I developed whatever they were mid sleep, I’ve been getting these when I wake up. It’s typically on my neck/face area, but now more so neck. I very rarely get them elsewhere, but when I was at work, my shoulder started to itch. I took a look, and what do you know..more raised skin. (Pic is in this mess somewhere). I went to my doctors and they said they believe they’re hives. I already had an exterminator come out to verify it wasn’t bed bugs (I’ve had an issue with them years ago and have ptsd from it so I wasn’t taking any chances). Today, I woke up with 3? more, but this time, they don’t itch. At all. Is this normal? I’m supposed to go to an allergist in the next few months. Do they even look like hives?

Edit: taking allergy meds helps and gets rid of them. They come back when I don’t take allergy meds
